mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_SEQ , NAME , DESCRIPTION , PRICE , IMAGE_URL , STOCK , CATEGORY_TYPE , STATUS , DISCOUNT_RATE , SELL_COUNT , RATING , TAGS , BRAND , CREATE_DATE , UPDATE_DATE FROM TB_PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_SEQ = #{productSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRODUCT ( NAME, DESCRIPTION, PRICE, IMAGE_URL, STOCK, CATEGORY_TYPE, STATUS, DISCOUNT_RATE, SELL_COUNT, RATING, TAGS, BRAND, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{imageUrl}, #{stock}, #{categoryType}, #{status}, #{discountRate}, #{sellCount}, #{rating}, #{tags}, #{brand}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT PRODUCT_SEQ , NAME , DESCRIPTION , PRICE , IMAGE_URL , STOCK , CATEGORY_TYPE , STATUS , DISCOUNT_RATE , SELL_COUNT , RATING , TAGS , BRAND , CREATE_DATE FROM TB_PRODUCT WHERE CATEGORY_TYPE = #{categoryType} AND STATUS = 'ON' ORDER BY CREATE_DATE DESC
